verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a skills registry with a companion CLI, so publishing a REST API and an OpenAPI-style spec is a fair thing to ask of it, and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a downloadable API spec. A community member asking 'Please make a rest API!' suggests no public API exists, and the agentskills.io SKILL.md format specification describes a file format, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
